method: Ten alternating pairs per scenario, 1024 advanced ticks, one discarded full-window warmup pair. Run-only elapsed and process CPU from result.json; no telemetry/save/replay in timed run. Two gradient workers, delay8, AI threads2/4; in-use M3 workstation. First small-Castor outlier retained; no hand-picked exclusions. No simultaneous owned local validation/compression during timing. Linux performance not remeasured on final refactor.
